_note: case-document-drafts (decision 182: procedures are configuration, code is generic). A case type names, per purpose, the filinq template a document is drafted from and the data it renders. CaseDocumentDrafts asks filinq through its published DocumentGenerationRequestedEvent and files the draft on the case; CaseDraftData builds the data from this declaration. A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037.

documentDrafts.title: Document drafts
documentDrafts.description: The documents a case of this type can be drafted from a template, by purpose (for example decision): the filinq template, the format, the document type the draft is filed under, and the data it renders.

templateSlug.title: Template
templateSlug.description: The filinq template the document is drafted from, by slug.

templateNamespace.title: Template namespace
templateNamespace.description: The filinq namespace the template slug belongs to.

documentType.title: Document type
documentType.description: The document type the draft is filed under on the case.

dataKey.title: Data key
dataKey.description: When set, the built data sits under this key beside the case; otherwise beside the case directly.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: Values read off the case by dot path, or fixed, each optionally mapped through a list of allowed values.

lists.title: Lists
lists.description: Records related to the case, gathered into numbered rows with their own fields.

signing.title: Signing
signing.description: How the document is signed before it goes out, per language ({"nl": ..., "en": ...}). The letters route returns it in the reader's language for the case's letter card.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: How the document reaches the addressee, per language ({"nl": ..., "en": ...}). The letters route returns it in the reader's language for the case's letter card.

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description: One field of a list reduced to one answer: the shared value when every row agrees, otherwise the mixed answer.
